title: 安田記念の後に・サイレント連覇！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeing Vodka's dash pay off is a much bigger reward than the victory itself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On top of that, it completely slipped Vodka's mind that she was the defending champion—making the win that much cooler when she realizes her big feat.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having obtained a powerful edge, Vodka smiles, feeling that she can't lose to anyone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With her powerful, ultra cool new weapon, Vodka decides to run in the autumn Tenno Sho against her biggest rival, Daiwa Scarlet!
